faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Vectorify. Can't find your answer? Contact us.

chatbot.q: Is Vector just another AI chatbot?
chatbot.a: No. Vector is an orchestration system with 7 specialized agents working together. It's not passive Q&A; it's active guidance with memory, context, and accountability. Think: GitHub Copilot is to coding what Vector is to building entire projects.

existing.q: Can I use Vector with my existing tools?
existing.a: YES! That's the point. Vector integrates with Notion, ClickUp, GitHub, Figma, and 15+ other tools. We don't want to replace your workflow. We orchestrate it with strategic intelligence.

unique.q: What if my idea is very unique/specific?
unique.a: Vector's intent parser understands context. If you say 'I want to make TikTok for finance,' Vector knows that's different from 'Uber for pets' or 'a book about AI.' The agents generate custom strategies, not generic templates.

chatgpt.q: How is this different from using ChatGPT?
chatgpt.a: ChatGPT has no memory between conversations, gives generic advice, and is passive. Vector has complete project context, custom strategies per your industry, proactive agents that intervene when needed, integrations with your tools, and living documents that evolve.

free.q: Is the Free tier really free forever?
free.a: YES. No credit card required. No 'trial' that expires. 1 project, 2 agents, 10 missions/month = forever free. We believe in product-led growth. If Vector helps you, you'll upgrade when you're ready.

cancel.a: Absolutely. No contracts. Cancel with 1 click. Prorated refund if you cancel mid-month. We only want you paying if Vector is genuinely helping you.

refund.a: 30-day money-back guarantee. If Vector doesn't give you 10x clarity in the first month, email us and we refund. No questions asked.

student.a: 50% off Pro tier with valid .edu email. Also, special programs for: Accelerator cohorts (free for program duration), Non-profits (50% off), Underrepresented founders (scholarships available).

data.a: We collect your project information, usage data, and integration data. We DON'T sell your data (NEVER), train AI models on your confidential info, or share with third parties (except integrations you authorize).

secure.a: Yes. Encryption at rest (AES-256), encryption in transit (TLS 1.3), SOC 2 Type II compliant (in progress), GDPR & CCPA compliant. Enterprise tier includes SSO/SAML, custom data retention, and on-premise deployment option.

export.a: YES. Export everything anytime: JSON format (full data), PDF/PPTX (documents), CSV (analytics). No lock-in. Your data is YOURS.
